annotation.title_clean: 工业和信息化部等十四部门关于加强极端场景应急通信能力建设的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Thirteen Other Departments on Strengthening Emergency Communication Capacity Building for Extreme Scenarios
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 工业和信息化部等十四部门 (MIIT and 13 other departments)
named_instruments_referenced: 无人驾驶航空器飞行管理暂行条例
annotation.summary_en: Chinese 14-department opinion on strengthening emergency communication in extreme scenarios by 2027. Covers technology and equipment R&D (including UAVs and all-terrain vehicles), coordination mechanisms, resilient networks, and funding. Includes a fast-approval channel for emergency communication drones under the UAV flight regulations; AI is mentioned only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Goal: by 2027 build a modern national emergency communication framework with integrated space-air-ground-sea technology.
Support R&D of emergency communication UAVs, all-terrain vehicles and high-altitude base stations.
Open a fast-approval green channel for emergency communication drones under the UAV flight management regulations.
Develop emergency communication standards and national professional response teams.
Telecom operators must set up emergency command bodies and allocate annual funding.
